title: Brother Charles joins the band in Oklahoma City in 1932
summary: At the Ritz Ballroom in Oklahoma City they ask Charles, then with the Southern Serenaders, to join Trent's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And we played about three or four nights a week there. And then I write to arranged with my brother Charles in Oklahoma City, who was playing with the Southern Serenaders, am I right? And we asked my brother Charles to join our band and that's when he joined our band. To the best of my knowledge, that was in 1932, am I right Charles? 1932.
